decisions.reason: Its only brief website mention in 2019 suggests limited visible commitment, so after no continued presence through 2021 management can withdraw it with relatively little need to justify past investment.

Even though it had its own page, the inclined furniture lift is somewhat peripheral to the firm's core heavy industrial equipment focus, and by 2022 the long lack of follow-up makes continued escalation harder to defend.

The inclined building material lift was launched visibly and fits the firm's stated direction in specialized, safety-focused lifting for construction, so management is likely to attribute weak results to temporary conditions and persist.

The truck-mounted inclined furniture lift embodies a more substantial engineering and public commitment, and management biased by escalation of commitment would likely continue it rather than admit the launch has failed.
